description: Header file declaring utility functions for WebKit integration within the WebKitBrowser project. It includes functions for manipulating WKArrayRef, retrieving URLs, and converting WKStringRef to std::string.

methods.name: AppendStringToWKArray
methods.description: Appends a string item to a WKMutableArrayRef array.

methods.name: GetStringFromWKArray
methods.description: Retrieves a string from a WKArrayRef array at the specified index.

methods.name: GetURL
methods.description: Returns the current URL as a std::string.

methods.name: GetBundle
methods.description: Returns the WKBundleRef associated with the current context.

methods.name: WKStringToString
methods.description: Converts a WKStringRef to a std::string.

methods.name: ConvertWKArrayToStringVector
methods.description: Converts a WKArrayRef to a std::vector<std::string>.
